CustomField.description: Message shown when the rule fails. Merge fields such as {!PropertyName} or {!newRecord.Name} are filled from your context class. If you write your own context class, put @JsonAccess(serializable='always') on it, or its merge fields stay blank. Custom Labels are not resolved. To show a label, add a property to the context class that returns System.Label.YourLabel.
